title: Cognizant In Talks To Invest In Sarvam At $3.5 Bn To $4 Bn Valuation: Report
script:
Four billion dollars. That is the target valuation for Sarvam AI.
Cognizant Technology Solutions is in talks to join this new funding round.
The Nasdaq-listed IT services company wants a piece of the Indian AI unicorn.
Negotiations place the valuation between three point five and four billion dollars.
Sarvam AI develops foundational models focused on Indian languages and enterprise use.
Would you back enterprise AI built for local languages?
